description: Public-safe schema for representing interacting mechanisms as a directed graph without asserting domain-specific claims.
acceptance_criteria: Reject graphs with duplicate mechanism identifiers.
Reject interactions whose source or target does not reference a declared mechanism.
Reject undefined mechanism roles, interaction types, or confidence labels.
Require at least one observable output.
Reject private, personal, household, health, animal-care, financial, location, relationship, credential, or raw transcript markers.
Emit deterministic graph metrics for identical inputs.
falsification_route: The validator is falsified if it accepts invalid endpoints, accepts non-public metadata, accepts a graph without observable outputs, or emits different summaries for identical graphs.
